source: benchlm.ai/openai/api-pricing (page last-updated 2026-07-26), cross-checked against web search (cloudzero, aipricing.guru) on 2026-07-26
note: Prices are pinned for provenance. Cost per call = (prompt_tokens - cached_tokens)*input + cached_tokens*cached_input + completion_tokens*output, all /1e6. completion_tokens ALREADY INCLUDES reasoning_tokens for gpt-5* models, so reasoning is not double-counted. Where OpenAI publishes no cached-input rate we pin cached_input = input (a conservative over-estimate that can only make our accounting >= provider's).
